"You are my parent, and I will do my best to make you proud."

options.label: Herman
options.description:
Somewhat of a mad scientist, his obsession with creating life from the dead has left him with skills in graverobbing, with learning how to fleshwarp being his life's goal.

"It's alive. It's ALIVE. It definitely moved, right? It's alive!"

options.label: Tor'Dan Oinn
options.description:
A devourer, he has existed for centuries and gained many skills. He has come to see mortals as no more than cattle, but sees something special in you.

"I like humans, they're my favorite. They taste like chicken."

options.label: Zahra
options.description:
A Teb'lhran desert witch that heads a trading caravan through the great desert, she is not tied down to any place. She has a close knit family that she has raised from the dead.

"Many things are moved through the desert. But I do not ask questions."

options.label: Sasha
options.description:
Missing her soldier of a father, she raised him from the dead, finding out she has the power of necromancy. She is still learning how to control her gift, and wants a teacher.

"Can my daddy come too? I love my daddy."

options.label: Manyara
options.description:
A wandering girl without a care, she is cheerful and happy. She likes to fix animals that no longer live and make them live again. She is always open to learning more about the world.

"See, Mr. Birdy is flying again. Isn't that great?"

options.label: Emily
options.description:
A kindhearted, naïve girl, she was brought up by the dead that she raised. She will need to be looked after, however she has great untapped power and potential. 

"The once-living are so much more interesting than the now-living."

options.label: Afuzad
options.description:
A southerner of Teb'lhr, he has learnt much about necromancy and making the dead do his bidding. Considering other mortal beneath him, he seeks to conquer them.

"The buffoons don't strive to live forever. What fools."

options.label: Sir Henry
options.description:
Once a knight of repute slain dishonorably, he was raised from the dead by his daughter. He has unearthly martial prowess he uses to keep her safe, forever. 

"Even in death my love for her endures. I will protect my Sasha."

options.label: The Laughing Man
options.description:
A lich of renown, exiled from the monastery the liches once had for his puns. He knows a great deal about necromancy, and will once again have an apprentice.

"Don't you I'm humerus? You must lack a funny bone."

options.label: Jinpen
options.description:
A shaman from a tribe of kobolds, they are a kindhearted soul with few possessions. They raise the dead to aid them in releasing their burden and progress in the afterlife. 

"All is part of the wheel of life. Sometimes it needs a push."

options.label: Amenthes
options.description:
A legendary pharaoh with awesome power, martial skill and tactics, he awoke after millenia to again try the conquer the world in the name of the Child. Aiding him wil gain favor. 

"Only the world uniting stopped me. I have learnt form my mistake."

options.label: Nerrti
options.description:
Nerrti was a cunning priestess from the Child's temple, that can regenerate mummies without items. She can pass as living, and recognizes you as the next pharaoh.

"Yes, my pharaoh. Together we will succeed where Amenthes failed."

options.label: Eshe
options.description:
Accidentally awoken form death, her unlife requires her to be regenerated. She has aided temple members in the past with her magical skills and will aid you in the present.


"Ayah, I was so happy in the afterlife. I suppose I can return to my duties."

options.label: Lady of Pain
options.description:
Timeless as torture itself, her name forgotten, she is the oldest Eremite. Vast powers is hers, she commands her own Domum Lacrimans. She sees great promise in you.

"I have such sights to show you. Shall we begin."

options.label: Sefekhi
options.description:
A mage from the Child's temple, he has served as a priest and wizard with eldritch arts lost to time. 

He desires a master to serve and will carry out orders with great loyalty.

"The Child has slept for long enough. The time has come for them to wake."

options.label: Ceberron
options.description:
Ceberron is a venerable member of the Untamed Lands and knows many of its residents. He seeks to wake the Child once again, and will use his cultists to aid him.

"The Child has slept for long enough. The time has come for them to wake."

options.label: Ngawang
options.description:
Denizens of the Untamed Lands, ancients as the sands, he is a mummified lich with great power. He has forgotten more than most will know,m with skills now lost in time.

"The wind blows. The dunes dance. I endure it. It has always been such."

options.label: Teremum
options.description:
The most feared of all Eremites, he possesses an unbridled sadism. He has a desire to make the world his Domum Lacrimans, the power to make it so, but no worldly ally. 

"I will enjoy making them bleed. ANd I will enjoy making you enjoy it."

options.label: Margaret
options.description:
A windowed aristocrat with an undying love for her dead husband. She found you and will become your patron if you can bring him back. She possesses a vast fortune.

"My love for him is eternal. I would do anything for love."

options.label: Courtesan
options.description:
A beautiful woman of high standing in the courts of nobility, she is able to make men and even women fall under her sway. She looks like someone you once knew. 

"It's amazing what a few workds and a certain look can accomplish."

options.label: Escaped Slave
options.description:
Lucky to have her freedom from Zatmenyiri, she has been on the run. She performs housework well but never learnt anything else. She never had any other use. 

"I am free. Thank you. I-I have never known anything else."

options.label: Kobold Maid
options.description:
Skilled at housework, cooking and just about anything else that needs doing, she learns quickly and is smart enough to learn more than just menial or household tasks.

"Yes, dinner is in the oven. The house is spotless and the assassins dead."

options.label: Ekaterina
options.description:
Master of hunting dangerous prey, she lost her spear at the age of 12. Many slaves have been captured by her, she lives for the hunt. She will bring in many slaves for her master. 

"They never know I am there, not until it is too late. Then it is over."

options.label: Adjoa
options.description:
Priestess of the Mother, she cares for those that need aid. With divine powers of healing and the ability to repulse evil, she protects the weak. Those that help her prosper. 

"I serve the Mother in helping others. Will you do the same?"

options.label: Aisha
options.description: Used to commanding forces with sound judgement, she unflappable and a great tactician, able to rapidly adapt to any situation. She can lead your dead to resounding victory.

options.label: Maireni
options.description:
Traveling from place to place, she has refined her haggling and sales skills as well as her slight of hand and card playing. She performs minor magic but she can learn more. 

"Pick a card, any card. Oh, that one's a dagger."

options.label: Maajid
options.description:
Wandering the desert and the surrounding lands, he looks out for those that need help. He has skills with his weapons and a strong sense or morality. He can take a beating.

"The living deserve to continue living and I will ensure that happens."

options.label: Edward
options.description:
Wanting to crown himself the new Teb'lhran king, he needs an ally to make it happen. Political intrigue and playing games of thrones is his forte, with brutally efficient tactics. 

"I am sure we can arrange some deal. How about a duchy?"

options.label: Danarius
options.description:
A legendary warrior in search of a new purpose, he has supernatural strength and stamina. He desires a new master to put him against impossible odds, for a challenge. 

"Army of darkness? I call that Monday."

options.label: Albert
options.description:
The dead husband of Margaret, you raised him from the dead. He was a talented and noble knight before he died. He has skills as a commander but his loyalty is to his wife. 

"Than you kindly, stranger, but my wife is my purpose for living."

options.label: Dante
options.description:
An older man with a 0 defeat record, he is a professional tactician. He is endearing in an uncle-like way and will aid you in planning your battles. He is skilled with his claymores. 

"I have planned it all out, you see. First they come, then we get crazy."

options.label: Bandit Leader
options.description:
A mysterious individual that shares little beyond a common interest, they serve for their own reasons. With a gang of bandits behind them and a set of skills, they know how to win. 

"The only unfair fight is the one you do not win, so fight dirty."

options.label: Lobsang
options.description:
A quick and accurate writer, they studied the best Teb'lhran college and mastered the art of research. He is fluent in all but the world's languages. He is interested in necromancy.

"?? You mean elf. I learnt that in college."

options.label: Adegoke
options.description:
Old and set in his ways, he knows much that was kept secret by his order. He is the last in a long line of monks and is look for a successor to pass over his knowledge.

"No, that's not how you do it. Why? This is how it is done."

options.label: Bestial Vampires
options.description:
Beastly and feral with large fangs and massive wings, they are the mindless slaves of their creator. Cunning instead of intelligent, they prefer ambushing prey. 

Gain 5 per purchase

options.label: Vampire Bride
options.description:
Female nosferatu of a less bestial nature, they are utterly devoted to their creator. They have a child-like intellect combined with a slender yet strong frame, devoted to their sire.

Gain 3 per purchase

options.label: Dhampir
options.description: Born a half-breed, of one vampire parent and one not, if possesses all the powers of a vampire and none of its weaknesses. Sunlight does not harm them and they are immortal.

options.label: Vampire Knight
options.description: Created by turning a knight into a vampire, these are naturally skilled in warfare and their vampiric nature makes them even stronger. They are their sire's loyal servant.

options.label: Thrall
options.description:
Once mortal, these twisted beasts are creatures are now the mindles servants of their creator endowed with strength. Sterile, they cannot turn the living into vampires. 

Gain 2 per purchase

options.label: Hunter
options.description: Children of the night, hunters seek out their prey and drains their life. Stronger and faster than mortals with a thirst for blood rivaled by none. They are very stealthy.

options.label: Vampire
options.description: Once mortal, now these vampires are undead, and have the strength and speed of the nosferatu. Still like their mortal self, carried into their next life is their personality.

options.label: Vampire Guardian
options.description: Far more powerful than any kind of vampire, these guardians are bound to guard important places with their power. Nigh-invulnerable in addition to their immortality, for a price.

options.label: Wraith
options.description: Created when a dying mortal has undergone tremendous stress, this incorporeal spirit has massive amounts of negative energy and the power to harm the living.

options.label: Primeyst'Ma
options.description: A dark spirit created from the fatal torture of an individual, this spirit has powers able to cause unspeakable horror. A force of nature, they are all but unstoppable when unleashed.

options.label: Scheming Spirits
options.description:
Cunning and conniving courtiers in life, these spirits are manipulative. Capable of possessing mortals, but not moving things on their own. Binding them is a wise move. 

Gain 7 per purchase.

options.label: Living Armor
options.description: The soul of a warrior bound in armor. It has all the skills it once had in life, with supernatural reflexes and flexibility. The perfect bodyguard for almost any situation.

options.label: Shade
options.description: Created from the spirit of a twisted and deranged being, it possesses its intelligence from life, with a twisted imagination and a desire to cause mayhem at its creator's order.

options.label: Bestial Spirit
options.description:
Shaped from the soul of an animal, this spirit is intensely loyal to its master. Stronger than it was in life, it has keener sense as well. 

Either 10 small spirits or 1 large one.

options.label: Spectral Knight
options.description: The restless spirit of a long-lost knight that wanders this world. His weapon is ethereally sharp and cuts soul and flesh alike. The knight sees the one if found as its master.

options.label: Ghost
options.description: The ghost of a person, it is not able to mvoe on, and thus seeks out a purpose in this world. They do not have the skills to move things yet though they will learn one day.

options.label: Night Wing
options.description: One a bat, or a mortal, this creature now flies the skies at night, brutally murdering or kidnapping at the behest of its creator. It can resist arrows, though its wings cannot.

options.label: Abomniation
options.description: Perhaps once a mortal or another race, this monster has the strength of 10 men and brains of none. it will follow orders mindlessly and is ever loyal to its master.

options.label: Skinwalker
options.description:
Crafted from a mortal, its original appearance stolen, it serves its master in clandestine missions. 

It can look and sound like any mortal person, and it uses this well.

options.label: Greater Abomination
options.description: A hulking mass of undead flesh, abominations crush, kill, and destroy all that their master commands. Not bright at all, though it would take a miracle to kill one.

options.label: Created Life
options.description: Created from nothing by artificial means in a laboratory, they are an example of life created from unlife. Only superficially different from normal, they know only service.

options.label: Ghoul
options.description:
Mortality twisted into a gruesome caricature of itself, ghouls have sharp claws but only simple minds.

Hound-like, they serve their creator in any way that they can.

options.label: Chimæra
options.description: Created from the fision of three hounds together, this beast is the fleshmaster's loyal hound. Able to tear limb from limb and savage any target with its massive jaws.

options.label: Werewolf
options.description: One a regular mortal, now they are in possession of a second chance with a form more powerful than most and a master to obey. They serve their creator but are still intelligent.

options.label: Totenhund
options.description:
Risen dogs that blindly serve their creator, they are the most loyal of all undead. Able to rip the flesh from bone with great ferocity, their senses are also equally as sharp. 

Gain 2 per purchase.

options.label: Zombie Giant
options.description: One of the races not deemed to be possessing intelligence, this corpse was raised in its creator's service. Strenght unrivaled by anything and unliving endurance serve it well.

options.label: Death Knight
options.description: What once had lived now serves eternally with martial prowess. It is armored and armed with its sword, with an oath of service to its creator that binds it to their will.

options.label: Executioner
options.description: A master of ending lives, the skilled precision of its axe allows it to sever heads or limbs with equal accuracy. Not the fastest, nor the hardiest, but an executioner is deadly still.

options.label: Wight
options.description: A far rarer and even more powerful zombie, the wight has its intelligence intact. Even stronger and more durable than its mortal self, and loyal to its creator without question.

options.label: Wendigo
options.description: A mortal, that consumed their race's flesh in great quantities, hulking and undead with a hunger for flesh. Its strength depends on how much flesh it has in its stomach.

options.label: Zombie Gang
options.description:
The raised corpse of a slaughtered soldier, it has only that with which it died wearing. The skeleton serves its creator with unwavering loyalty and the strength it had in life.

Gain 10 per purchase.

options.label: Skeleton Gang
options.description:
A number of skeletons that were raised from a mass grave, alone they are not very strong, but they are rarely alone. Animated with magic alone, they do not possess a soul.

Gain 10 per purchase

options.label: Lesser Eremite
options.description: A mortal transformed in a ritual taking Eremite form, granted powers in exchange for eternal servitude. Clad in Eremetic vestments, they carry out the orders of their master.

options.label: Eremite
options.description: A surreal master of exquisite pain, this being becomes stronger when injured. It can call forth instruments of torment, and resides in your Domum Lacrimans until summoned.

options.label: Amkhata
options.description:
Created when an Eremite is killed, mummified, and resurrected: It has incredible durability and weakened powers of Eremites and mummies. 

They live to experience pain.

options.label: Cultists
options.description:
Mortal followers of the Child that have devoted their lives to it.Secretive, they control a number of places to further their goals. Serving the Child gains their loyalty.

Get 4 per purchase.

options.label: Akert
options.description: The honored dead of a deceased soldier from the Untamed Lands that was raised into eternal service. It will fight tirelessly for its master in the service of the Child.

options.label: Khri-Habi
options.description:
Priests of ages long-past recently resurrected, they continue their work again under a new master. 

Skilled at word-craft, their speech is convincing to those in need.

options.label: Sadikh
options.description: Servants beyond the clutches of death, their powers are limited but their ability to complete tasks set stand them apart from the rest.

options.label: Kher-Minankh
options.description: Created from kobolds warped beyond nature and entrusted with the task of defending temples from all invaders. They are incredibly strong and remarkably resilient.

options.label: Plague Zombie
options.description:
Zombies that are infected with a plague crafted by their creator.

The zombies will spread the plague wherever they go but may inspire terror in people that see them.

Get 5 per purchase

options.label: Ripper
options.description: Created from a person twisted by both blood magic and flesh magic. A vampiric desire for blodo with a need for brutality of its own, its strength and speed inspire fear.

options.label: Corruption
options.description: A ritually cursed spirit imbued with plaguebearing, it possesses bodies and burns through them quickly. It transforms the host into a powerful monster that obeys its creator.

options.label: Bone Golem
options.description: A construct structurally strengthened by its spirit. They are bound to obey their creator with their supernatural strength and stamina, and can replace any lost bones but no more.

options.label: Slave
options.description:
Purchased from the elves, these people are bound to serve. Not well treated but fearfully obedient. they will do whatever they are told and are considered expendable. 

Get 5 per purchase

options.label: Master Smith
options.description: A skilled maker of weapons and armor with arts passed down from father to son, he is able to craft pieces of art that can save lives as well as take them away.

options.label: Merchant
options.description: Encountered in travel, a merchant with an intriguing array of wares. He may add puzzles to his stock, and anything else that seems like it is interesting and worth selling.

options.label: Assassin
options.description: A master assassin skilled in the arts of disguise, poison, and killing. Willing to serve if it benefits them, and they enjoy money and murder. They serve for fun and fortune.

options.label: Evdokiya
options.description: One of the elves from deep in the forests of Valaistir, she is looking to find a new home. She has skills in hunting and tracking, and seeks a new master to make use of them.

options.label: Turned Huntress
options.description: Once an agent of the Mother's Church, then turned by the Punaini. She is a friendly but brutal person. Willing to follow orders as long as they are violent. Likes using whips.

options.label: Tavern Wench
options.description: A woman with no combat skills that wishes to work in a tavern or inn. She can cook, clean, and serve meals and drinks, and knows how to handle rowdy customers.

options.label: Scholar
options.description: A person with no combat skills, scant real-world experience but a wealth of knowledge and skills in researching and finding secrest and information on most topics.

options.label: Thief
options.description: Skilled in the arts of infiltration, they wish only to make coin, and have ambiguous morals at best. If ownership needs to change hands then they are the people to have.

options.label: Accomplice
options.description: A person convinced that aiding a necromancer would be benefificial to their station, they carry out orders and can walk through towns without raising suspicion.

options.label: Groundskeeper
options.description: Does not ask questions, just takes care of the place. They know how to clean and keep things in order, and can serve as manager or similar roles but will not assist in the dirty work.

options.label: Mother's Priest
options.description: A moral guide and steadfast man wielding the power of healing. They aid the destitute and help the poor, abhor slavery, combat, and evil with their Mother-given magic.

options.label: Disgraced Guard
options.description: A skilled combatant that lost their high standing after failing to protect their charge. Exiled from their home and forced into vagrancy, they offer their sword to any new master.

options.label: Kobold Warrior
options.description: A kobold with a knack for fighting dirty that is in need of a home. Not the bravest or the tallest, but are willing to serve a new master, for the glory of the Child.

options.label: Kobold Bard
options.description: A wandering minstrel with a sharp tongue and talent for hurdy-gurdy playing, they write and play music. They may serve a master and spread their message through song.

options.label: Kobold Veteran
options.description: Seasoned in combat and skilled at fighting, they have a desire to prove themselves further. Not very well equipped, serving a person or cause is their way to prove themselves.

options.label: Alchemist
options.description: Master of the art of alchemy and skilled in the science of chemistry they create new potions with a slew of interesting effects. Will pursue morally gray topics for science.

options.label: Debauched Priest
options.description: The town's spiritual leader, they (sometimes secretly) worship the Father and seek to gain power. They know secrets about the flesh and the gods and will share with their master.

options.label: Soldiers
options.description:
A pair of soldiers with no allegiance that pledged themselves to a new master. With friends in several towns and skills at fighting, they can also train other living beings to fight. 

Get 2 per purchase

options.label: Lone Wolf
options.description: Cursed with an immortality they never chose and a new bestial power beyond their understanding, this person seeks a master to make sense of their new life and powers.
